class.name: SteamNetworking
class.brief_description: Read Steam relay readiness and inspect an admitted Game peer's transport path.
class.description: Access from [method SteamClient.networking] or [method SteamScope.networking]. The Game scope resolves [method peer_path] from current Steam-verified participants and their exact live gameplay sockets. Standalone sockets expose their own [method SteamSocketConnection.path].

method.name: relay_status
method.description: Returns Steam's latest relay readiness. An inactive or unsupported scope returns an unknown snapshot.

method.name: warm_relay
method.description: Starts Steam relay preparation. [constant OK] means preparation was requested. Observe [signal relay_status_changed] or query [method relay_status] for readiness.

method.name: peer_path
method.description: Samples the exact current remote Steam-verified Game peer. Returns [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER] for an invalid ID, [constant ERR_UNAVAILABLE] without a live Game sampler, or [constant ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST] when the peer has no matching admitted live socket.

signal.name: relay_status_changed
signal.description: Emitted when Steam reports a relay availability update. The argument is a detached snapshot.
